methods.label: Group the negative factors
methods.explanation: With 2 negative factors (an even number), the product is positive: first calculate \((-2)\times(-5)=10\), then \(10\times7=70\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 multiplication laws and sign rules, with elementary recognition of an even count.
